candidates.design: Global, double-blind, randomized phase III, 760 patients; atezolizumab plus tiragolumab, atezolizumab alone or placebo for up to 17 cycles
candidates.reason: The hierarchically tested atezolizumab-plus-tiragolumab comparison failed primary INV-PFS (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.65–1.03; P=0.0947) and OS (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.70–1.18). Atezolizumab-alone comparisons were descriptive after hierarchy failure; no confirmatory positive primary claim.
candidates.next_action: Retain for nuanced consolidation review; extract protocol hierarchy and do not treat descriptive monotherapy findings as confirmatory.

candidates.setting: Maintenance after response to first-line chemoimmunotherapy
candidates.design: Phase III randomized maintenance trial; niraparib plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab-based control
candidates.reason: Primary phase III result: in the CR/PR primary population median BICR PFS was 5.55 months in both arms; HR 1.00 (95% CI 0.79–1.27), one-sided P=0.502. No benefit from adding niraparib.
candidates.next_action: Retain as negative maintenance-intensification evidence; do not promote exploratory secondary endpoints as formally positive.

candidates.trial: Induction TPF versus adjuvant PF after CCRT in locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma
candidates.setting: Locally advanced; induction versus adjuvant chemotherapy around CCRT
candidates.design: Multicentre randomized phase III, N=266; induction TPF then CCRT versus CCRT then PF
candidates.reason: 3-year PFS 79.0% versus 74.5% (P=0.454), with no significant OS/LRFS/DMFS difference; induction arm had more grade 3–4 leukopenia and neutropenia.
candidates.next_action: Retain as sequencing/contrary evidence; extract full dose schedules and toxicity denominators.
